run_make_config: run make_config to generate a config file with enable_llvm_env and enable_mlir_env flags
create_config_file: create a config file at a specified path with LLVM and MLIR environment toggle settings
build_config_with_llvm: build a config file with enable_llvm_env set to true using the make_config CLI tool
build_config_with_mlir: build a config file with enable_mlir_env set to true using the make_config CLI tool
review_make_config: review the make_config function that parses CLI args and writes enable_llvm_env and enable_mlir_env to a file
